name: faceid-chain-verify
description: A pipeline that detects a face in an input image, generates a 512-d embedding, performs reverse image search via Google Cloud Vision API, filters results to social-media domains, builds a canonical match record, pins it to IPFS (Pinata), and anchors the record hash + IPFS CID on a smart contract on Polygon Amoy testnet. Records can later be verified by recomputing the hash and comparing on-chain.
